title: Three of the nine sit on East Riverside
subtitle: Crashes at each intersection since 2010, through Aug. 28, 2026
alt: Bar chart of crashes since 2010 at three East Riverside Drive intersections in Austin, all within about half a mile of each other: East Riverside Drive at South Pleasant Valley Road, 244 crashes, the most of any intersection in the city; East Riverside Drive at Willow Creek Drive, 157 crashes, the second most; and East Riverside Drive at Wickersham Lane, 114 crashes, the fifth most. Nine Austin intersections have had more than 100 crashes since 2010. The figures run through August 28, 2026.
source: Austin Transportation and Public Works data, analyzed by KXAN
